title: Make-Ahead Mango Coconut Chia Pudding
hook: Thanksgiving is over. Five minutes tonight and breakfast is done for the week: mango coconut chia pudding that tastes like dessert
benefit: Fiber and omega-3s from the chia, protein from the Greek yogurt and vitamin C from the mango
ingredients: 2 tbsp honey or maple syrup, divided
2 cups diced ripe mango (fresh, or frozen and thawed)
steps: Whisk the coconut milk, Greek yogurt, 1 tablespoon of the honey, the vanilla and the salt in a bowl until smooth. Stir in the chia seeds.
Let it sit for 10 minutes, then whisk again to break up any clumps. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight, until thick and spoonable.
Toss the mango with the lime juice and the remaining 1 tablespoon of honey. Mash about half of it with a fork so you get a saucy layer with chunks.
Toast the coconut flakes in a dry skillet over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring, until golden. Cool on a plate.
Divide the pudding among 4 jars, spoon the mango on top and finish with the toasted coconut. Lid on; they keep in the fridge for up to 5 days.
vo_steps: Whisk coconut milk, Greek yogurt, honey, vanilla and salt, then stir in the chia seeds.
Rest ten minutes, whisk again, then chill at least four hours or overnight.
Toss the mango with lime and honey and mash half of it for a saucy layer.
Toast the coconut flakes in a dry pan for two to three minutes until golden.
Layer pudding, mango and coconut in four jars. Breakfast is done for the week.
